name: What factors should I consider when choosing a location for my Studio ADU on my property?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a location for my Studio ADU on my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right location for your Studio ADU involves several key decision factors, including available space, setback requirements, utility access, and desired privacy. You'll need to adhere to local zoning regulations regarding minimum distances from property lines and existing structures. Access to sewer, water, and electrical connections will significantly impact installation costs and complexity. Consider how the ADU will affect light and views for both your main home and your neighbors. For example, in a densely populated area like Berkeley, maximizing vertical space or using a detached corner might be more feasible than a sprawling ground-level unit.
acceptedAnswer.description: When choosing a Studio ADU location, consider available space, setback regulations, utility access, and privacy for both your home and the ADU. Local zoning, such as in Berkeley, will heavily influence placement.
